title: CPSC, BCI Burke Announce Recall of Buckle Bridges on Series 2000 Playgrounds
summary: The platform edge, where the bridges are attached, can crack and the bridge could potentially detach from the platform and result in injuries. Units: 46.

title: CPSC, Bradford White Corporation, Announce Recall of Gas Water Heater
summary: The water heater may have been fitted with incorrectly made flue gas baffles. These baffles may affect fuel combustion, resulting in excessive carbon monoxide emissions, which can cause serious injuries and death. Units: 1,220.

title: CPSC, Cannondale Corp. Announce Recall of Bicycles With Defective Stems
summary: The stem can break away from the bicycle, causing a loss of control, falls and serious injury to riders. Units: About 1,300.

title: CPSC, Cavagna North America Inc., Announce Recall of Safety Relief Valves for Large Propane Tanks
summary: The recalled valves can have sharp internal edges that can cut into gasket seals in the valves, causing a propane gas leak. This poses a risk of fire or burn injuries. Units: About 6,100.

title: CPSC, Marin Mountain Bikes Announce Recall of Mountain Bikes
summary: The steer tube on the front of these bicycles can break off from the two main tubes of the frame, causing the rider to lose control, fall and possibly suffer serious injury. Units: About 1,000.

title: CPSC, Proctor-Silex Announce Recall of Steam Iron
summary: The circuit board inside the steam iron can ignite and present a fire hazard. Units: Approximately 970.

title: CPSC, Carrier Guam Announce Recall of Room Air Conditioners
summary: Salty sea spray can cause the electrical capacitor within these units to corrode, posing a possible fire hazard. Units: About 2,100.

title: CPSC, Babyliss Pro Announce Recall of Hairdryers
